entities.name: RibBA
observations: A 404-residue bifunctional riboflavin-biosynthesis protein with an N-terminal DHBP synthase domain and C-terminal GTP cyclohydrolase II domain.
Sequence matches reviewed RibBA homolog Q11WK6 at 71.5% identity over 99.0% query coverage and Q5LHT1 at 67.1% identity over 98.5% coverage.

entities.name: RibBA DHBP synthase reaction
observations: D-ribulose 5-phosphate is converted to (2S)-2-hydroxy-3-oxobutyl phosphate, also called 3,4-dihydroxy-2-butanone 4-phosphate, plus formate and H+.
This is EC 4.1.99.12 and corresponds to Rhea RHEA:18457.

entities.name: RibBA GTP cyclohydrolase II reaction
observations: GTP is converted to 2,5-diamino-6-hydroxy-4-(5-phosphoribosylamino)-pyrimidine, formate, phosphate, and protons; the product is also described as DARP or AARP.
This is EC 3.5.4.25 and corresponds to Rhea RHEA:23704.

entities.name: RibBA metal cofactors
observations: Reviewed homologs are annotated to bind two Mg2+ or Mn2+ ions and one Zn2+ ion per subunit.

entities.name: Riboflavin biosynthesis
observations: RibBA catalyzes the entry steps from D-ribulose 5-phosphate and GTP toward intermediates used to synthesize riboflavin.
